intent: Extend the already cleared OMNIS WING R3.1.1 selected ordinary non-stream chat path with a production-capable macOS signer enrollment boundary and an operator-facing offline verifier/health surface. The build must make readiness and evidence integrity visible without silently creating, rotating, exporting, or weakening keys, and without expanding governed egress coverage.
audience: JourdanLabs Captain and an independent gate deciding whether the selected WING path is ready to move from a test-only Ed25519 signer toward explicit operator-controlled production enrollment.
role: a security-minded Python engineer working only in the isolated OMNIS WING fork, preserving the R3.1.1 proof and keeping the live WING installation untouched
done:
Defines a production signer adapter contract backed by macOS Keychain/Secure Enclave capabilities where the platform supports them, plus a test-only adapter used by cold tests
Adds an explicit enrollment command or API that requires an affirmative operator action, records only non-secret key metadata/fingerprint, and never enrolls, rotates, deletes, or exports a key merely because WING starts
Makes the governed R2.1 chat join refuse before client invocation when the configured production signer is absent, unavailable, mismatched, or cannot durably sign the pre-send receipt
Adds an offline operator verifier/health surface that reports enrollment state, signer/key identifier and public fingerprint, receipt/chain verification result, signed-versus-unsigned counts, coverage boundary, and remote-anchor state honestly
Makes a missing remote anchor visibly UNCONFIGURED or NOT_CONFIGURED, never green; it is not implemented as network replication in this leg
Ensures verifier/health output is secret-free and contains neither payload cleartext nor bare SHA-256 of low-entropy test markers
Provides cold tests proving no-enrollment refuses with client 0, explicit enrollment is required, signer failure refuses with client 0, malformed/corrupted receipt is surfaced invalid, unanchored evidence is labelled honestly, and all R1/R2/R3.1.1 controls remain green
Writes BUILD_HANDOFF.md with exact commit, CADMUS authority SHA, evidence, operator commands, and non-claims
non_goals:
Performing a real enrollment in the Captain's login Keychain during the build or test run
Mutating ~/.omnis-wing/omnis-wing, live WING profiles, Videl configuration, or user credentials
Implementing remote-anchor replication, key rotation/revocation, hardware attestation, cross-platform production support, packaging/pushing, streaming, other providers, whole-tree egress control, or full ABSOLUTE certification
Claiming fsync proves remote durability or claiming historical unsigned rows have become signed
constraints:
Work only in ~/projects/omnis-wing on top of cleared R3.1.1 head 13c5a7febc2d7593e4c3a8d3f4d2c134d634023e
No live Keychain/Secure Enclave creation, deletion, rotation, or credential prompt in automated tests; use an injected test adapter or disposable test backend
Production enrollment must be explicit and idempotent: a pre-existing matching key may be reported, but ambiguity or mismatch must stop visibly rather than choosing a key
Private material never appears in a receipt, ledger, health payload, exception, log, filename, or command output
Health is observational and cannot clear a failed verifier; unknown/missing states must remain visibly unknown/missing
Use only existing declared dependencies or platform facilities; if a production-capable macOS adapter cannot be implemented without adding a dependency or creating credentials, stop REFUSED_AS_UNSAFE and report the precise constraint
Gate all tests cold/offline and do not self-certify; builder hands an exact re-gate packet to Bulma
format: A narrow OMNIS WING R4 commit: signer adapter/enrollment boundary, test adapter, offline verifier/health surface, selected R2.1 join wiring, cold can-fails, coverage-manifest update, and BUILD_HANDOFF.md. It binds to this authority SHA-256 and repeats the selected-path-only boundary.
